code.title: {{repository}}: code map
code.description: The modules this repository says it is made of, and what each depends on, from a file it keeps itself.
code.legend: Each arrow points from a module to what it depends on; what uses a module sits above it.
code.file: Read from {{file}}, which the repository keeps and Daoris never writes.
code.fed: Read from {{file}} at {{commit}} on {{branch}}, fed {{when}} by {{origin}}, and brought here by the sync. The repository keeps it; Daoris never writes it.
code.none.fedBody: The workspace's deployment holds commit {{commit}}, which keeps none. The repository draws its own and commits it, like its decisions log.
code.refused: Its code map was refused, whole:
code.none.headline: {{repository}} keeps no code map
code.none.body: A repository draws its own: docs/code-map.json, committed like its decisions log. Daoris reads it and never writes it.
code.detail.hint: Choose a module to see what it depends on and what uses it.
